WITH SignalCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        t3.observstation AS observatory_name,
        COUNT(t1.signalregistry) AS total_signal_count,
        AVG(CASE WHEN t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'High' OR t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'Urgent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_priority_score,
        AVG(t2.corrscore) AS approx_ccs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'High' OR t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'Urgent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS important_signals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t2.corrscore > 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_confidence_signals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'High' OR t4.analysisprio ILIKE 'Urgent') AND t2.corrscore > 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_criteria_signals
    FROM 
        signals AS t1
    JOIN 
        telescopes AS t3 ON t1.telescref = t3.telescregistry
    JOIN 
        signalprobabilities AS t2 ON t1.signalregistry = t2.signalref
    JOIN 
        researchprocess AS t4 ON t1.signalregistry = t4.signalref
    GROUP BY 
        t3.observstation
)
SELECT 
    observatory_name,
    total_signal_count,
    avg_priority_score,
    approx_ccs,
    important_signals,
    high_confidence_signals,
    both_criteria_signals
FROM 
    SignalCounts
ORDER BY 
    both_criteria_signals DESC;

WITH SignalMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        t.observstation AS observatory_name,
        COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS total_signal_count,
        AVG(
            CASE rp.analysisprio 
                WHEN 'High' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
                WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS avg_priority_score,
        AVG(sp.corrscore) AS avg_confirmation_confidence_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rp.analysisprio = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS important_signals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sp.corrscore > 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_confidence_signals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rp.analysisprio = 'High' AND sp.corrscore > 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_criteria_signals
    FROM 
        telescopes t
    JOIN 
        signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
    JOIN 
        researchprocess rp ON s.signalregistry = rp.signalref
    JOIN 
        signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
    GROUP BY 
        t.observstation
)
SELECT 
    observatory_name,
    total_signal_count,
    avg_priority_score,
    avg_confirmation_confidence_score,
    important_signals,
    high_confidence_signals,
    both_criteria_signals
FROM 
    SignalMetrics
ORDER BY 
    both_criteria_signals DESC, important_signals DESC, high_confidence_signals DESC;

WITH eccs AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref,
        CASE 
            WHEN avg(esi) > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg(esi) BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg(esi) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS avg_scanning_suitability
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se,
        LATERAL (
            SELECT 
                (
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN -5 AND 40 THEN 100
                            WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN -10 AND -5 OR se.ambictemp BETWEEN 40 AND 50 THEN 75
                            ELSE 50
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 100
                            WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 30 OR se.humepct BETWEEN 70 AND 80 THEN 75
                            ELSE 50
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.illumelux > 10000 THEN 100
                            WHEN se.illumelux BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 75
                            ELSE 50
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.geosignal = 'Excellent' THEN 100
                            WHEN se.geosignal = 'Good' THEN 75
                            WHEN se.geosignal = 'Poor' THEN 50
                            ELSE 25
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.trackstatus = 'Fixed' THEN 100
                            WHEN se.trackstatus = 'None' THEN 50
                            ELSE 25
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.linkstatus = 'Connected' THEN 100
                            WHEN se.linkstatus = 'Disconnected' THEN 50
                            ELSE 25
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.photomap = '90%' THEN 100
                            WHEN se.photomap = '80%' THEN 80
                            WHEN se.photomap = '60%' THEN 60
                            ELSE 40
                        END
                    ) +
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN se.imgcount > 500 THEN 100
                            WHEN se.imgcount BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN 75
                            WHEN se.imgcount BETWEEN 100 AND 200 THEN 50
                            ELSE 25
                        END
                    )
                ) AS esi
        ) esi_calc
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
) 
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS location_id,
    s.zonelabel AS location_name,
    eccs.avg_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    eccs ON s.zoneregistry = eccs.zoneref;

SELECT

    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    COUNT(sm.facetregistry) AS total_mesh_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(sm.facetregistry)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS high_fidelity_proportion,
    AVG(sm.facetverts / sm.facetfaces) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
    AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
    AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy,
    m.mesh_quality
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
JOIN 
    (SELECT zoneref, 'High Quality' AS mesh_quality FROM scanmesh WHERE uvmapqual = 'High'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT zoneref, 'Standard Quality' AS mesh_quality FROM scanmesh WHERE uvmapqual <> 'High') m
ON 
    s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
GROUP BY 
    s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel, m.mesh_quality
ORDER BY 
    site_code DESC;

            WHEN ss.avg_temperature BETWEEN 16 AND 25 THEN 'Mild' 
            ELSE 'Hot'

            WHEN ss.avg_humidity BETWEEN 30 AND 60 THEN 'Moderate' 
            ELSE 'Humid'

        CASE 
            WHEN ss.avg_illumination < 10000 THEN 'Low Light'

        flowsoft AS processing_software,

WITH SilentSupporters AS (
    SELECT 
        f.nicklabel,
        f.userregistry,
        (ms.spendusd + cc.merchspendusd + cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd) AS economic_impact,
        e.engrate AS engagement_rate,
        ms.membkind AS membership_tier,
        (ms.spendusd / (i.engagement_metrics->>'watchhrs')::decimal) AS revenue_per_view,
        e.contpref AS content_preference_classification,
        (
            (cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd + cc.merchspendusd) / (
                ms.spendusd + cc.merchspendusd + cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd
            )
        ) AS activity_ratio,
        (i.engagement_metrics->>'chatmsg')::decimal / (i.engagement_metrics->>'liveatt')::decimal AS chat_to_session_ratio,
        mv.monetization_value
    FROM 
        fans f
    JOIN 
        membershipandspending ms ON f.userregistry = ms.memberfanpivot
    JOIN 
        engagement e ON ms.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
    JOIN 
        commerceandcollection cc ON e.engagereg = cc.commerceengagepivot
    JOIN 
        interactions i ON e.engageactivitypivot = i.activityreg
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            ms.memberfanpivot,
            (ms.spendusd + cc.merchspendusd + cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd) / (
                e.engrate + 1
            ) AS monetization_value
        FROM 
            membershipandspending ms
        JOIN 
            engagement e ON ms.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
        JOIN 
            commerceandcollection cc ON e.engagereg = cc.commerceengagepivot
        JOIN 
            interactions i ON e.engageactivitypivot = i.activityreg
    ) mv ON f.userregistry = mv.memberfanpivot
    WHERE

        t.observstation AS observatory_name,

        AVG(

                WHEN 'High' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
                WHEN 'Low' THEN 1

        ) AS avg_priority_score,

    t.telescregistry AS telescope_id,
    -- Calculate the quality score
    (o.atmostransparency * 100) + 
    CASE 
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Excellent' THEN 100
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Good' THEN 75
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Poor' THEN 25
        ELSE 0
    END AS calculated_score,
    -- List equipment problems
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.equipstatus) AS equipment_problems,
    -- Count the number of issues
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.equipstatus) AS issue_count,
    -- Determine confidence level based on seeing profile
    CASE 
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Excellent' THEN 'High'
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Good' THEN 'Medium'
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Poor' THEN 'Low'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS confidence_level
FROM 
    observatories o
JOIN 
    telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
GROUP BY 
    o.observstation, t.telescregistry, o.atmostransparency, o.seeingprofile
ORDER BY 
    calculated_score DESC;

WITH oqf AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.observstation, 
    -- Calculate Observation Quality Factor (OQF)
    (
      t1.atmostransparency * t1.lunardistdeg * t2.pointaccarc
    ) AS calculated_score,
    -- Classify Observational Confidence Level (OCL)
    CASE 
      WHEN t1.atmostransparency > 0.5 
        AND t2.equipstatus = 'Operational' 
        AND t2.calibrstatus = 'Current' THEN 'High'
      WHEN t1.atmostransparency BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.5 
        AND t2.equipstatus = 'Degraded' 
        AND t2.calibrstatus = 'Due' THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS confidence_level
  FROM 
    observatories AS t1
    JOIN telescopes AS t2 ON t1.observstation = t2.observstation
),
site_issues AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation, 
    ARRAY[
      equipstatus, procqueuestatus
    ] AS equipment_problems,
    -- Count the number of issues
    ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY[
      equipstatus, procqueuestatus
    ], 1) AS issues_count
  FROM 
    telescopes
)
SELECT 
  t1.observstation AS name,
  t3.telescregistry AS "telescope ID",
  t2.calculated_score,
  si.equipment_problems,
  si.issues_count,
  t2.confidence_level
FROM 
  observatories AS t1
  JOIN oqf AS t2 ON t1.observstation = t2.observstation
  JOIN telescopes AS t3 ON t1.observstation = t3.observstation
  JOIN site_issues si ON t1.observstation = si.observstation
ORDER BY 
  t2.calculated_score DESC;

WITH RankedScans AS (
    SELECT 
        arcref, 
        cloudregistry, 
        scanresolmm, 
        coverpct, 
        noisedb, 
        (
            (10.0 / scanresolmm) ^ 1.5 
            * (coverpct / 100.0) 
            * (1 - (noisedb / 30.0)) ^ 2
        ) AS sqs, 
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY arcref ORDER BY (
            (10.0 / scanresolmm) ^ 1.5 
            * (coverpct / 100.0) 
            * (1 - (noisedb / 30.0)) ^ 2
        ) DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        scanpointcloud
)
SELECT 
    arcref, 
    cloudregistry, 
    scanresolmm, 
    coverpct, 
    noisedb, 
    sqs
FROM 
    RankedScans
WHERE 
    rank > 1;

  SELECT 
    spc.arcref, 
    (coverpct * (100 - noisedb)) AS sqs,
    s.questregistry
  FROM 
    scanpointcloud AS spc
    JOIN scans AS s ON spc.arcref = s.arcref
)

  arcref, 
  MAX(sqs) AS max_sqs, 
  questregistry
FROM 
  sqs
GROUP BY 
  arcref, questregistry;

    JOIN distributionhubs AS d ON t.transporthubref = d.hubregistry

    SELECT

        CASE

        END AS status
    FROM lpm_cte AS l
    JOIN transportation AS t ON l.transportregistry = t.transportregistry
)

    l.transportregistry, 
    lpm, 
    status
FROM lpm_cte AS l
JOIN logistics_breakdown_cte AS lb ON l.transportregistry = lb.transportregistry;

        t.battlifeh AS battery_life,

        d.pwridlemw AS idle_power_consumption,
        d.pwractmw AS active_power_consumption,

        testsessions t

        deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
    WHERE

            (battery_capacity / 3.6) / -- Convert mAh to Wh
            NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0) -- Average power consumption in mW
        ) * 10 AS battery_efficiency_ratio,
        CASE 
            WHEN ((battery_capacity / 3.6) / NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0)) * 10 > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'
            WHEN ((battery_capacity / 3.6) / NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0)) * 10 BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.5 THEN 'Good Efficiency'
            WHEN ((battery_capacity / 3.6) / NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0)) * 10 BETWEEN 2.5 AND 4.9 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
            ELSE 'Poor Efficiency'
        END AS battery_efficiency_classification
    FROM 
        wireless_devices wd
),
percentile_ranking AS (

    (
        r.rgbbright * 0.2 + 
        r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + 
        r.rgbzones * 0.15 + 
        CAST(NULLIF(r.rgbmodes, '') AS NUMERIC) * 0.15 +

    -- Classify RGB Quality based on the calculated score
    CASE
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + CAST(NULLIF(r.rgbmodes, '') AS NUMERIC) * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) > 8.0 THEN 'Premium RGB Implementation'
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + CAST(NULLIF(r.rgbmodes, '') AS NUMERIC) * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.0 THEN 'High-Quality RGB'
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + CAST(NULLIF(r.rgbmodes, '') AS NUMERIC) * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) BETWEEN 3.0 AND 5.9 THEN 'Standard RGB'
        ELSE 'Basic RGB'
    END AS rgb_classification

    deviceidentity d
JOIN 
    testsessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN 
    rgb r ON d.devregistry = r.rgbregistry
ORDER BY 
    rgb_implementation_quality_score DESC;

    p.powratew::float AS power_ratings,
    perf.measpoww::float AS current_power,
    (
        perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct'
    )::float AS degradation,
    env.soillosspct::float AS soiling_loss,
    (inv.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::float AS inverter_losses,
    -- Calculate Total System Loss (TSL) per panel using Inverter Efficiency Loss (IEL)
    (
        (p.powratew::float * (1 - (
            perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct'
        )::float/100))
        * (1 - env.soillosspct::float/100)
        * (1 - (inv.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::float/100)
    ) AS total_system_loss
FROM 
    panel p
JOIN 
    performance perf ON p.panemark = perf.solmodref
JOIN 
    environment env ON p.hubregistry = env.arearegistry
JOIN 
    inverter inv ON p.hubregistry = inv.siteref

WITH tsl_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        p.panemark AS panel_id,
        p.powratew AS power_rated_w,
        pe.measpoww AS measured_power_w,
        e.soillosspct AS soiling_loss_pct,
        CAST(i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct' AS NUMERIC) AS inverter_efficiency_pct,
        CAST(pe.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct' AS NUMERIC) AS cum_deg_pct
    FROM 
        panel p
    JOIN 
        performance pe ON p.panemark = pe.solmodref
    JOIN 
        environment e ON p.hubregistry = e.arearegistry

    panel_id,

    measured_power_w,
    soiling_loss_pct,
    inverter_efficiency_pct,

        (power_rated_w * cum_deg_pct / 100) + 
        (measured_power_w * soiling_loss_pct / 100) + 
        (measured_power_w * (1 - inverter_efficiency_pct / 100))
    ) AS total_system_loss
FROM 
    tsl_cte;
